assessments.reasoning: The precise append clause in the tagged go1.23 specification matches the registered digest. It mandates a sufficiently large new underlying array when capacity cannot accommodate the additional values and specifies reuse otherwise. The candidate asserts only the insufficient-capacity branch.

challenge.method: Apply both branches to a valid append with one extra element when length equals capacity, and when there is one free position. Check whether the new capacity or physical allocation method is specified.
challenge.results: The first case selects the new-array branch and the second selects reuse. The section constrains the size only enough to hold the resulting elements and describes the language-level array behavior.

limitations: The cited branch sets no growth factor or physical placement requirement.
